summary: Backend-only testing of Jessi AI vehicle reference fix. All 15 tests passed. Verified: (1) POST /purchases with category='vehicle' syncs personal_details.vehicle_purchased and clears vehicle_details. (2) build_relationship_brief() ai_context shows 'Most recent purchase: Road Glide' (not Mojave) when purchase_history exists. (3) Mojave does not appear in 'Most recent purchase' line after Road Glide is added. (4) Stale Mojave vehicle_details not shown in ai_context after new purchase. (5) Legacy contacts (no purchase_history) still correctly show vehicle_details from personal_details.

minor.issue: HTTP endpoint strips ai_context from the brief before returning — the field is not exposed externally. Tests required direct Python import to verify ai_context. This is by design but worth noting if Jessi AI ever needs to debug context via API.

critical_code_review_comments: The contact creation endpoint (POST /contacts/{user_id}) does NOT accept or persist personal_details in the request payload — contacts need a separate PATCH /personal-details call to set them. This is by design but could confuse integrators.

The has_purchase_history gate in relationship_intel.py line 321-334: when purchase_history exists AND the memo vehicle matches current vehicle (name substring match), vehicle_color IS still shown. This is correct — color is still relevant to current vehicle. vehicle_details gets cleared by add_purchase() so won't appear.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up 4 test contacts (TEST_Jessi VehicleFix*) during test run
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 bug fix scenarios verified via pytest. Key findings: (A) add_purchase() correctly syncs personal_details.vehicle_purchased='Road Glide' and clears vehicle_details='' for category='vehicle'. (B) build_relationship_brief() correctly uses purchase_history most-recent title ('Road Glide') in ai_context, gating out stale Mojave references. (C) Legacy contacts (no purchase_history) still show vehicle_details from personal_details. Note: The HTTP relationship-brief endpoint does NOT return ai_context field — had to use direct Python import to test it.
rca_of_issue: Root cause 1: build_relationship_brief() was feeding personal_details.vehicle_purchased (Mojave from old voice memo) directly into the AI context even when purchase_history had a more recent entry (Road Glide). Fix: has_purchase_history variable gates the personal_details vehicle fields. Root cause 2: add_purchase() was not updating personal_details.vehicle_purchased, so even after adding a new vehicle purchase, the voice-memo field still referenced the old vehicle. Fix: add_purchase() now sets personal_details.vehicle_purchased=title and personal_details.vehicle_details='' when category='vehicle'.
